_about: Bad Eden Paths: Surge overlays chosen at 1st level (a second at 17th), each with three doctrines. Entries use the same shape as the universal Surge menu (cost, minProf, label, fiction, fx). 'doctrine' limits an entry to one doctrine; 'perk' marks free doctrine moves available from 1st level. Design source: the 'Bad Eden Paths' Claude Doc.

bulwark.name: Path of the Bulwark
bulwark.tagline: Set your feet. The line forms on you.

entry.name: Hold the Line
entry.description:
Hold the Line (free). Once per round, as a reaction when a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack, you can become the target instead.

The wall runs on what hits it: the first time each round you take damage, you bank 1 Surge.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.tagline: You belong here now. Argue with the mountain.

perk.name: Rooted
perk.description: Rooted. You have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can't be pushed or knocked prone while you haven't moved this turn.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.tagline: You do not stop. They learn this the hard way.

perk.name: No Terminal Velocity
perk.description: No Terminal Velocity. Your walking speed increases by 5 feet, and difficult terrain doesn't slow you.

cataclyst.name: Cataclyst
cataclyst.tagline: Something gives way. You aim where.

perk.name: Stance Dance
perk.description: Stance Dance. At the start of your turn you can take Advance or Anchor for free (from the Surge menu); it lasts until your next turn.

abilities.label: Brace the Line — +2 AC to you or a targeted ally against one attack
abilities.fiction: You set your shoulder where the blow will land.

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when the attack hits: it can turn the hit into a miss.

abilities.label: Steady Feet — advantage on Str and Dex saves; you can't be moved

fx.note: Until your next turn you can't be moved or knocked prone.

abilities.label: Absorbing Guard — resist one damage type; your next melee hit adds 1d6 of it
abilities.fiction: You take it in, and you keep it.

fx.auto: Your next melee hit adds 1d6 of the absorbed type.

abilities.label: Shelter — you and allies within 10 ft gain temp HP equal to twice your Prof
abilities.fiction: Stand behind me. All of you.

abilities.label: Bastion — 1 minute: +1 AC and resistance to weapon damage
abilities.fiction: You become the wall the others lean on.

fx.note: Concentration: it ends if your concentration breaks.

abilities.label: Unbroken — at 0 HP, rise to 1 and gain temp HP equal to your level (1/long rest)
The Last Wall — 1 minute: allies within 10 ft resist all damage
abilities.fiction: Everything they throw finds you first.

fx.note: For the duration you can't drop below 1 HP.

abilities.label: Denial — a creature trying to move past you stops dead
abilities.fiction: You decide which side of you is the wall.

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when a creature within 5 ft tries to move past you.

abilities.label: Shockwave Arrival — your next melee hit also strikes everyone around the target

fx.note: After moving at least 10 ft in a straight line, your next melee hit also deals its weapon damage to every other creature within 5 ft of the target (apply it from the damage card).

abilities.label: Advance — +2 melee damage, −1 AC until your next turn
Anchor — +1 AC, half speed until your next turn
Decide the Weather — a wall of debris, or an eruption
abilities.fiction: One. Or the other. Not both. Decide.

fx.note: Wall: a 30-ft line of debris gives full cover until it's cleared. Or Eruption: a 30-ft line, each creature makes a Dex save, 4d8 bludgeoning, half on a success.

entry.name: Aura
entry.description:
Aura (free). As a bonus action, take up one of four Auras from the Surge menu; it lasts until you change it. Fury: +1 damage on melee weapon attacks. Resolve: +1 AC while you haven't moved this turn. Mercy: you can deal nonlethal damage at no cost, and a creature you drop to 0 HP can be left stable. Dread: creatures within 5 ft of you have disadvantage on saves against being frightened.

Burn, as Surge: the first time each round you hit with a melee weapon attack, you bank 1 Surge.

perk.name: Centered Breath
perk.description: Centered Breath. You and allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.

perk.name: Lifetithe
perk.description: Lifetithe. Once per turn (0 Surge, from the Surge menu), take damage equal to your Prof and bank 1 Surge.

voidedge.name: Void Edge
voidedge.tagline: Entropy has a shape. I cut along it.

perk.name: Null Field
perk.description: Null Field. A creature you hit with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

abilities.label: Aura: Fury — +1 melee weapon damage
Aura: Resolve — +1 AC while you haven't moved this turn

fx.note: The +1 AC only counts on turns you haven't moved.

abilities.label: Aura: Mercy — nonlethal at no cost; the fallen can be left stable

fx.note: Nonlethal damage costs you nothing; a creature you drop to 0 HP can be left stable.

abilities.label: Aura: Dread — creatures within 5 ft have disadvantage on saves vs fear

fx.note: Creatures within 5 ft of you have disadvantage on saves against being frightened.

abilities.label: Press Harder — your next melee hit deals +Prof damage and pushes 5 ft

fx.auto: Your next melee hit deals +Prof damage.
fx.note: That hit also pushes the target 5 ft.

abilities.label: Stand Firm — resist one damage type; you can't be moved

fx.note: Until your next turn you can't be moved against your will.

abilities.label: Take It for Them — an ally takes Prof less from each hit this round

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when the ally is hit.

abilities.label: Dread Mark — a foe has disadvantage on attacks and no reactions
Overheat — 1 minute of +Prof melee damage, then a backlash
abilities.fiction: Past the safe line, on purpose.

fx.note: When it ends, you have disadvantage on your next attack roll and your next saving throw.

abilities.label: Not on My Watch — an ally at 0 HP rises to 1 with temp HP = your level (1/long rest)
Aura Unbound — 1 minute: allies within 10 ft share your Aura
Eye of the Storm — 1 minute: allies within 10 ft have advantage on Wisdom saves
abilities.fiction: Violence happens around you. It does not take you.

fx.note: Fear and charm on them are suppressed for the duration.

abilities.label: Lifetithe — take Prof damage, bank 1 Surge (once per turn)
Crimson Arc — your next melee hit also deals half its damage to another creature in reach

fx.note: Your next melee hit also deals half its damage to another creature within your reach (apply it from the damage card).

abilities.label: Dread Cut — a creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you

harmony.name: Path of the Harmony Marshal
harmony.tagline: You're not the hero. You're the reason the heroes don't trip over each other.

entry.name: Resonance
entry.description: Resonance (free). When an ally within 30 ft banks Surge, you bank 1 too, up to half your Prof (rounded down) per round. Surge you bank this way never sets off another Marshal's Resonance.

perk.name: Accord Partner
perk.description: Accord Partner. At the start of each combat, name one ally. When either of you hits a creature, the other has advantage on their next attack against it.

perk.name: All-Seeing
perk.description: All-Seeing. +5 passive Perception, and you can't be surprised.

perk.name: The Long Watch
perk.description: The Long Watch. When you lead a short rest, each ally who spends Hit Dice regains extra HP equal to your Prof.

abilities.label: Rallying Words — an ally has advantage on their next d20 roll
abilities.fiction: The right word, at exactly the right moment.

abilities.label: Ease Attrition — heal an ally 2d6 + Prof and end one condition
Rally to Me — an ally moves half speed to you and has advantage on their next d20

fx.note: Reaction: they move up to half their speed toward you without provoking.

abilities.label: Unity Flourish — every ally within 30 ft has advantage on their next d20
abilities.fiction: The dice obey because you asked nicely.

abilities.label: Conductor's Crescendo — allies within 30 ft: advantage, temp HP = Prof, end a condition
abilities.fiction: The whole line, on one breath.

fx.note: Each ally may also end one condition on themselves (GM applies).

abilities.label: One Breath — until your next turn, allies within 30 ft have advantage on attacks
Synchronized Advance — every ally within 30 ft has advantage on their next attack
abilities.fiction: The second blow lands in the hole the first made.

abilities.label: Locked Perimeter — this round, allies within 30 ft take Prof less from each hit
Second Wind — ward an ally: their next drop to 0 HP stops at 1

courier.name: Path of the Shadow Courier
courier.tagline: You're already moving. The fight rearranges around it.

entry.name: In Motion
entry.description:
In Motion (free). The first time each round you move 30 ft or more on your turn, you bank 1 Surge.

The Package. You can carry one Package at a time: a message, a key, a person, a secret. Delivering it fills your Surge to maximum (your GM confirms the delivery from the Surge menu).

perk.name: The Tongue That Does Not Lie
perk.description: The Tongue That Does Not Lie. While carrying a message, you have advantage on Insight checks about its recipient and on Persuasion checks to reach them.

blackstair.name: Black Stair
blackstair.tagline: You came through a door that wasn't for them.

perk.name: Blade or Key
perk.description: Blade or Key. At the start of each scene, carry one. Blade: your first attack from hiding or surprise deals an extra 1d10. Key: open one ordinary lock or password without a roll.

lastmile.name: Last Mile
lastmile.tagline: Give it to me. I carry things.

perk.name: The Arms That Carry
perk.description: The Arms That Carry. Pick up an unconscious or willing ally as a bonus action and carry them at your full speed.

abilities.label: The Package — delivered: Surge to full (your GM confirms)
Courier's Step — move half your speed without provoking

fx.note: Move up to half your speed; this movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.label: Ghoststep — Prof less damage per hit until your next turn; slip 10 ft

fx.note: Move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

abilities.label: The Crossing — pass through a door, wall or ward up to 5 ft thick (1/short rest)
abilities.fiction: The membrane chooses you instead of the wall.

fx.note: As part of your move, pass through one door, wall or ward up to 5 ft thick. Ordinary barriers don't register you; a magical ward needs a Dexterity check against its DC.

abilities.label: Flank & Strike — your next attack has advantage and deals +Prof d6

fx.auto: Your next attack has advantage and deals +Prof d6 damage.

abilities.label: Unfound Route — step through one doorway and out of another you've crossed (1/long rest)
abilities.fiction: Every threshold you've crossed remembers you.

fx.note: Out of combat: you and up to four allies step through one doorway and out of another you have personally crossed before.

abilities.label: No Such Door — allies within 30 ft move half speed free and have advantage on their next d20
abilities.fiction: Open the road for the whole team.

fx.note: Each ally can immediately move up to half their speed without provoking.

abilities.label: Safe Passage — an ally takes Prof less per hit this round and has advantage on their next d20
Cut Off — a creature can't take reactions and has 0 speed until your next turn
Shoulder the Weight — heal an ally 2d6 + Prof; you take half; they have advantage next

wyrdlens.name: Path of the Wyrdlens Adept
wyrdlens.tagline: Every structure has a flaw. You only have to look at it correctly.

entry.name: The Lens
entry.description: The Lens (free). Probability Overlay: once per round, roll one of your own d20s with advantage (0 Surge, from the Surge menu). The seam shows: the first time each round a creature within 60 ft of you fails a saving throw, you bank 1 Surge.

truth.name: Truth
truth.tagline: I see what you actually are.

perk.name: The Reading Eye
perk.description: The Reading Eye. Truesight out to 10 ft.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.tagline: You already know how this goes.

perk.name: Half a Second Early
perk.description: Half a Second Early. Add your Prof to initiative rolls.

perk.name: The Prevented Blow
perk.description: The Prevented Blow. Once per round, as a reaction, reduce the damage an ally within 10 ft takes from one hit by your Prof.

abilities.label: Probability Overlay — your next d20 has advantage (once per round)

fx.auto: Your next d20 roll has advantage.

abilities.label: Foresight — you or an ally has advantage on the next d20 roll
Expose — a creature has disadvantage on its next attack and its saves
Refract — an ally takes Prof less from each hit this round

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when the ally is hit.

abilities.label: Read the Seam — your next attack has advantage and ignores resistances

fx.auto: Your next attack has advantage and ignores the target's resistances.

abilities.label: Revelation — allies within 30 ft have advantage next; a targeted foe has disadvantage next
Tikkun Sight — a missed spell hits, or a save it allowed fails (1/long rest)

fx.note: When your spell or power misses every target or every target saves, treat one target as hit or as having failed (GM applies).

abilities.label: The Exposure — a creature can't take reactions and has disadvantage on saves
abilities.fiction: Nowhere left to put an intention.

abilities.label: The Stopped Strike — the next hit on an ally this round misses
abilities.fiction: The strike simply declines to land.

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when a creature hits the ally.

abilities.label: Redirected Harm — an ally takes Prof less per hit and is warded at 1 HP
abilities.fiction: Send it into the wall instead.

linguist.name: Path of the Cosmic Linguist
linguist.tagline: Strike the clause. Insert your own. Reality reads from the top.

entry.name: The Next Word
entry.description:
The Next Word (free). At the start of each round of combat you bank 1 Surge.

The Sentence. While you concentrate on a spell or power, its main target has disadvantage on ability checks against you.

annotator.name: Annotator
annotator.tagline: See below. It changes everything above.

perk.name: Footnote
perk.description: Footnote. Once per round, as a reaction, add 1d4 to a d20 roll an ally within 30 ft just made.

metaphor.name: Metaphor Apostle
metaphor.tagline: Say what counts as what now. Reality is listening.

perk.name: Declared Likeness
perk.description: Declared Likeness. Once per turn (0 Surge, from the Surge menu): "you are a wall". A targeted ally gains +1 AC until your next turn.

redactor.name: Redactor
redactor.tagline: It is not there anymore. It was never there.

perk.name: Clean Edges
perk.description: Clean Edges. Once per short rest (0 Surge, from the Surge menu), end the charmed or frightened condition on yourself or an ally you can see.

abilities.label: Emphasis — your next attack or spell that hits deals +Prof d6

fx.auto: Your next damage roll adds Prof d6.

abilities.label: Stabilize — Prof less damage per hit and advantage on concentration until your next turn
Impose a Reading — a creature has disadvantage on its next attack and its saves
Strike the Clause — end one condition on an ally
Rewrite the Sentence — a foe: no reactions, disadvantage on saves; allies: advantage next
Final Draft — a creature that just saved against you fails instead (1/long rest)

fx.note: A creature that just succeeded on a save against your spell or power fails it instead (GM applies).

abilities.label: Revision — every ally within 30 ft has advantage on their next d20
Declared Likeness — "you are a wall": an ally gains +1 AC (once per turn)
Declared Frailty — "their armor is paper": AC −2 and disadvantage on its next attack
Clean Edges — end charmed or frightened on you or an ally (once per short rest)
abilities.fiction: Clean edges where it used to be.

abilities.label: Silence — a creature can't take reactions or speak until your next turn

fx.note: It can't take reactions or speak (no verbal components) until your next turn.

dreamwalker.name: Path of the Dreamwalker
dreamwalker.tagline: The future is just memory pointed the other way.

entry.name: Saw It Coming
entry.description:
Saw It Coming (free). The first time each round an enemy within 60 ft of you misses an attack, you bank 1 Surge.

The Dream-Cache. After a long rest, store one 1st–3rd level spell or power you know (from the Surge menu). Before your next long rest you can cast it once without spending a slot or points.

perk.name: The Revelation
perk.description: The Revelation. Once per long rest, ask the GM one question; the answer is true.

sapphire.name: Sapphire Gate
sapphire.tagline: Every threshold is also a doorway.

perk.name: Gate-Touched
perk.description: Gate-Touched. Once per turn, 10 ft of your movement can be a teleport to a space you can see.

perk.name: Borrowed Face
perk.description: Borrowed Face. You can change your appearance at will, as the disguise self spell.

abilities.label: Dream-Cache
abilities.fiction: The dream remembers it for you.

abilities.label: Omen — you or an ally has advantage on the next d20 roll
Dream Ward — an ally takes Prof less per hit this round and has advantage next
Shared Dream — allies within 30 ft: advantage on their next d20 and temp HP = Prof
abilities.fiction: Everyone dreams the same way out.

abilities.label: Sleepwalk — a creature makes a Wisdom save or is incapacitated until its next turn ends

fx.note: Taking damage wakes it.

abilities.label: Reality Hack — allies within 30 ft have advantage next; a targeted foe has disadvantage next
Memory Pointed the Other Way — the last roll within 60 ft is rolled again (1/long rest)

fx.note: Undo the last attack roll, save or check made within 60 ft: it is rolled again and the new result stands (GM applies).

abilities.label: Radiant Pause — targeted creatures make a Wisdom save or can't attack until their next turn ends
abilities.fiction: A beat of peace nobody asked for.

abilities.label: Sapphire Step — you and an ally teleport up to 30 ft; both have advantage next

fx.note: You and the ally each teleport up to 30 ft to spaces you can see.

abilities.label: Mirror Read — a foe has disadvantage next; you have advantage and take Prof less per hit
abilities.fiction: You wear its tell back at it.

soulsmith.name: Path of the Soul-Smith
soulsmith.tagline: Give me time, a fire, and something to hit, and then we'll see.

entry.name: The Forge
entry.description: The Forge (free). The first time each round you or an ally within 30 ft takes damage, you bank 1 Surge.

perk.name: The First Vessel
perk.description: The First Vessel. Your Forge-Weld and Furnace of Renewal heal an extra amount equal to your Prof.

perk.name: The Victor's Spark
perk.description: The Victor's Spark. When a hostile creature within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, you bank 1 Surge (once per round).

perk.name: Where the Heat Was
perk.description: Where the Heat Was. Your Forge-Weld also ends one condition.

abilities.label: Forge-Weld — an ally within 5 ft heals 1d8 + Prof
Atonement Crucible — end one condition on an ally; they take Prof less per hit this round
abilities.fiction: The bad thing is now load-bearing.

abilities.label: Temper — an ally gains resistance to one damage type for 1 minute
Furnace of Renewal — you and allies within 30 ft heal 1d8 + Prof and resist poison for 1 minute
abilities.fiction: Stand near the fire. It is rude not to.

abilities.label: Relic of Rebirth — ward an ally for 1 minute: their next drop to 0 HP stops at 1
The Forge Does Not Accept "Dead" — an ally who died this minute returns at half HP (1/long rest)

fx.note: Only for an ally who died within the last minute.

abilities.label: The Sealed Work — an ally takes Prof less per hit and is warded at 1 HP
Forged Trophy — your next hit deals +Prof d6; an ally takes Prof less per hit this round
abilities.fiction: A weapon and a shield, both made of someone's worst day.

fx.auto: Your next damage roll adds Prof d6.

abilities.label: Deep Salvage — an ally heals 2d8 + Prof and every condition on them ends
abilities.fiction: Some ruins are worth the dig.

pactkeeper.name: Path of the Pactkeeper
pactkeeper.tagline: Every manifestation is an agreement with something. Most casters don't read what they signed. You did.

entry.name: The Bargain
entry.description: The Bargain (free). Upkeep paid: at the start of each of your turns in combat, if you are concentrating on a spell or power, you bank 1 Surge.

archivist.name: Archivist of Precedent
archivist.tagline: Every ruling has already been made. I know where.

perk.name: Read the Ledger
perk.description: Read the Ledger. Advantage on checks to recall laws, treaties, history and precedent.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.tagline: Show me the books. I will find the clause.

perk.name: The Examination
perk.description: The Examination. After watching a creature for a round, ask the GM one of its resistances, immunities or vulnerabilities.

steward.name: Steward of Living Communities
steward.tagline: The contract exists to serve the people bound by it.

perk.name: The Protected Clause
perk.description: The Protected Clause. You and allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being charmed.

abilities.label: Countersign — you or an ally has advantage on the next d20 roll
Renegotiate — a failed concentration save succeeds; you owe a favor

fx.note: Reaction when you fail a concentration save: you succeed instead. The GM notes a favor you now owe.

abilities.label: Binding Clause — a creature makes a Wisdom save or its speed is 0 until its next turn ends
Sealed Pact — 1 minute: advantage on concentration saves, +1 spell and power save DC
Writ of Protection — 1 minute: you and allies within 30 ft can't be charmed or frightened
Ledger Day — a willing ally takes over one spell you're concentrating on (1/long rest)
abilities.fiction: The pact moves with the paper.

fx.note: The ally takes over concentration on one spell or power you are concentrating on (GM applies).

abilities.label: Invoke Precedent — a creature makes a Charisma save or can't attack you or your allies

ae.name: Bound by Precedent (can't attack the party)

fx.note: Attacking it ends the effect.

abilities.label: Formal Correction — end one spell or magical effect on a creature, as dispel magic
abilities.fiction: In violation of its own terms.

fx.note: End one spell or magical effect on the creature, as dispel magic cast at a level equal to your Prof (GM applies).

abilities.label: Sanctuary — 1 minute: allies within 10 ft can't be charmed, frightened or moved
abilities.fiction: The contract serves the people bound by it.

fx.note: They also can't be moved against their will.
